name: Evelyn Rodriguez
title: Founder
conviction_themes: Best founders uncover hidden demand first and build second — not the other way around
Vertical AI founders should target BPO/services spend as the beachhead revenue strategy
5–10 design partners is the right number for mid-market vertical AI — more causes product creep
Weekly AI prototyping pushes turn skeptical enterprise partners into engaged collaborators
Physical-world AI is an underrated wave compared to digital/software AI
previous_experiences: Founder at HacerHouse, running vertical AI founder community and roundtables in San Francisco
bio_text: Evelyn Rodriguez is the founder of HacerHouse, a San Francisco Bay Area venture focused on the vertical AI founder ecosystem. She convenes roundtables for vertical AI founders spanning healthcare, real estate, automotive, and veterinary sectors, and is known for her conviction that founders must start with hidden demand before building product. Her background spans cultural/talent catalysis, relationship marketing, and internet community building, with a longstanding presence in the SF Bay Area tech scene.
